title: Well-Tempered Clavier I: Prelude No. 20 in A minor
video_use_ideas: Forceful minor-key drive for a confrontation beat.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 670 ('Das Wohltemperierte Clavier I, Praeludium XX', for Harpsichord, Piano); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Stelios Samelis). Edition source: Bach Gesselschaft Edition (1866). Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
